subject: Islamic Studies
title: Aqeedah 1: Tawhid and its opposite
source: Aqeedah_1_Summary_TeacherVoice (video and transcript). Arabic terms and Qur’an references to be checked by a teacher before pupils use it.

summary.title: What is aqeedah?
points: From al-ʿaqd: to tie something firmly, like a tight knot
In the religion: firm belief held in the heart, with no doubt at all
It is the foundation: no deed is accepted without tawhid
It is why we were created, and where every prophet began, from Nuh to Muhammad ﷺ

keywords.d: firm belief held in the heart, certain with no doubt
to tie something firmly, like a tight knot

summary.hint: Aqeedah is held firmly in the heart, with no doubt at all

summary.title: Tawhid and ar-Rububiyyah
points: Tawhid: to make something one; in Islam, to single out Allah alone in all that belongs only to Him
Three types: ar-Rububiyyah (Lordship), al-Uluhiyyah (worship), al-Asma' was-Sifat (names and attributes)
Rububiyyah: Allah alone creates, owns and controls everything
The people of Makkah believed Allah was the Creator, yet still worshipped idols. Believing is not the same as worshipping

quote.text: And if you asked them who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon, they would surely say, “Allah.”

keywords.d: singling out Allah alone in everything that belongs only to Him
Allah alone creates, owns and controls everything
Allah's perfect names and attributes, belonging to Him alone

summary.hint: The people of Makkah believed that, yet worshipped idols; tawhid also needs worship for Allah alone

summary.title: Al-Uluhiyyah: tawhid of worship
points: Singling out Allah alone with all worship; also called tawhid al-ʿibadah
It is the meaning of the shahadah: lā ilāha illā Allāh, nothing deserves worship except Allah
Worship includes duʿa', salah, sacrifice, vows, fear, hope, love and trust
Giving any of these to other than Allah is shirk

quote.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

keywords.d: singling out Allah alone with all worship
nothing deserves to be worshipped except Allah

summary.hint: Worship includes duʿa', sacrifice, vows, fear, hope, love and trust too

summary.title: The excellence of tawhid
points: No deed is accepted without it; it saves on the Last Day
It repels harm, wipes away sins and brings ease to the heart
Every deed needs two things: ikhlas (for Allah alone) and following the Sunnah
Yunus (ʿalayhi as-salām) called out with tawhid inside the whale; a good word is like a good tree

quote.text: There is no god worthy of worship except You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

keywords.d: doing a deed for Allah alone
doing a deed the way the Prophet ﷺ did it

summary.hint: A deed needs ikhlas and to follow the Sunnah

summary.title: Four proofs that Allah exists
points: Fitrah: the natural belief in Allah every person is born with
Intellect (ʿaql): the universe could not come from nothing or make itself
Senses (hiss): duʿa' is made and the answer is seen, as with Ayyub (ʿalayhi as-salām)
Revelation (sharʿ): its law fits perfectly and its news comes true

quote.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators?

keywords.d: the natural belief in Allah every person is born with
the intellect: reasoning that the universe needs a creator
revelation: its law fits perfectly and its news comes true

summary.hint: It was seen and felt, so it is a proof from the senses

summary.title: Shirk: the opposite of tawhid
points: Shirk: associating partners with Allah in anything that belongs to Him alone; the person is a mushrik
It is the greatest sin and a tremendous injustice
It can break any of the three types of tawhid
We learn about it to avoid it and warn others with wisdom, never with insults (al-Anʿam 6:108)

quote.text: O my son, do not associate anything with Allah. Indeed, shirk is a tremendous injustice.

keywords.d: associating partners with Allah in what belongs to Him alone

summary.hint: Shirk can break any type of tawhid, including giving Allah's names and qualities to others

questions.question: Which word does 'aqeedah' come from, and what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Aqeedah comes from al-ʿaqd, to tie something firmly like a tight knot: belief tied firmly to the heart.

wrong.1: ʿAql is the intellect, one of the proofs that Allah exists, not the root of aqeedah.

questions.question: In the religion, aqeedah is…
options: Firm belief in the heart with no doubt
Belief that may still have some doubt
questions.explanation: Aqeedah is firm belief held in the heart, certain with no doubt at all.

wrong.3: Aqeedah has no doubt at all; that is what makes it firm.

questions.question: What are the three types of tawhid?
questions.explanation: Tawhid of Lordship, of worship, and of Allah's names and attributes.

wrong.2: Fitrah, ʿaql and hiss are proofs that Allah exists, not types of tawhid.

questions.question: Tawhid ar-Rububiyyah means Allah alone…
questions.explanation: Rububiyyah is Lordship: creating, owning and controlling.

wrong.1: Being worshipped alone is al-Uluhiyyah, not ar-Rububiyyah.

questions.question: The people of Makkah believed Allah was the Creator. Why was that not enough?
options: They did not know His names
They did not pray five times
questions.explanation: They affirmed Rububiyyah but broke Uluhiyyah by worshipping others. Believing is not the same as worshipping.

questions.question: What does tawhid al-Uluhiyyah mean?
options: Singling out Allah alone with all worship
questions.explanation: Uluhiyyah, also called tawhid al-ʿibadah, is singling out Allah alone with all worship.

wrong.1: That is ar-Rububiyyah. Uluhiyyah is about our worship.

questions.question: Which ayah tells us why we were created?
options: “I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me”
“Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion”
“A good word is like a good tree”

questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed as a form of worship in the unit?
questions.explanation: Worship includes duʿa', salah, sacrifice, vows, fear, hope, love and trust.

questions.question: What does lā ilāha illā Allāh mean?
options: Nothing deserves to be worshipped except Allah
questions.explanation: It is the meaning of tawhid al-Uluhiyyah: no one deserves worship except Allah.

wrong.2: Allah creating everything is Rububiyyah; the shahadah is about worship.

questions.question: What two things does a deed need to be accepted?
options: Ikhlas and being seen by others
questions.explanation: Ikhlas: done for Allah alone. The Sunnah: done the way the Prophet ﷺ did it.

wrong.1: Intention matters, but the deed must also follow the Sunnah.

questions.question: What did Prophet Yunus (ʿalayhi as-salām) call out with inside the whale?
options: Tawhid: there is no god but You
questions.explanation: Al-Anbiya' 21:87: there is no god worthy of worship but You, glory be to You…

questions.question: In the parable of the good tree, what is the good word?
questions.explanation: The good word is lā ilāha illā Allāh: roots firm, branches reaching the sky (Ibrahim 14:24).

questions.question: Name the four proofs that Allah exists.
questions.explanation: The natural disposition, the intellect, the senses and revelation.

questions.question: “Every child is born upon the fitrah.” Which proof is this?
questions.explanation: Fitrah is the natural belief in Allah that every person is born with.

questions.question: Allah answered Ayyub's duʿa' and removed his harm. Which proof does this show?
questions.explanation: The answer to duʿa' was seen and felt, so it is a proof from the senses.

wrong.1: The intellect is reasoning, e.g. the universe cannot make itself. Ayyub's cure was seen and felt.

questions.question: “Were they created by nothing, or were they the creators?” uses which proof?
questions.explanation: It asks us to reason: nothing comes from nothing and nothing makes itself, so the universe has a Creator.

questions.question: Why is shirk the greatest injustice?
options: It gives worship to one who does not deserve it
It is hard to repent from
questions.explanation: Worship is Allah's right alone; giving it to others is the greatest wrong.

questions.question: Making duʿa' to a grave, asking it for help, breaks which type of tawhid?
questions.explanation: Duʿa' is worship, so giving it to other than Allah breaks tawhid of worship.

questions.question: How should we warn others about shirk?
questions.explanation: Allah forbids insulting what others call upon, so they do not insult Allah in return (al-Anʿam 6:108).

wrong.1: Al-Anʿam 6:108 forbids insulting what they call upon.
